title: TMA causes & malignant hypertension
guide: The cause list (HUS, HELLP, catastrophic APS/diffuse scleroderma with anti-RNA P as small-vessel disease vs Takayasu/PAN large-vessel) and malignant hypertension = accelerated HTN + papilloedema with ≥180/120 emergency HTN.

title: HUS triad, TTP pentad & typical vs atypical
sec: HUS Triad, TTP Pentad & Types · p753
guide: The triangle triad (thrombocytopenia, renal failure, MAHA) vs the TTP pentagon (adds GI symptoms, fever, neurological), and the types table: D+ childhood dysentery good prognosis vs D- genetic/sporadic with 50% ESRD and post-transplant recurrence.

title: Pathophysiology & typical toxins
guide: Endothelial damage → VWF → platelet plug → trapped platelets (thrombocytopenia) and schistocyte/MAHA arm; the 90% typical-childhood toxin trio (verocytotoxin-EHEC O157:H7, Shiga-Shigella dysentery, neuraminidase-Strep pneumoniae).

title: Atypical genetics, drug lists & investigations
sec: Atypical HUS Genetics, Drugs & Investigations · p754
guide: Alternate-pathway genetics with low C3/normal C4, factor-H (m/c)/factor-B (worst)/MCP (best)/factor-I, drug-induced vs immune-mediated lists with ticlopidine-clopidogrel 'TTP also', and the work-up: >2% schistocytes, Coombs-negative hemolysis labs, normal PT/APTT, plus the SLE complement comparison.

title: Presentation, treatment & pre-renal vs ATN
sec: Presentation, Treatment & Pre-renal vs ATN · p755
guide: Typical HUS timeline (abdominal pain → 2 d bloody dysentery → 5 d → 90-95% resolve / 5-10% HUS, conservative Rx) vs atypical (2° HTN features, PLEX within 24 h mainstay, eculizumab, CFH-mutation immunosuppressant, transplant and recurrence drugs), closing with the pre-renal vs ATN table.
